items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: Yeah, well you've got Pops Foster and Paul Ballgren, Monty Johnson and Eddie Conda and Louie Russell.

ctx.x: Yeah, well you've got Pops Foster and Paul Ballgren, Monty Johnson and Eddie Conda and Louie Russell.
Oh, they're just playing. That's all you know. Yeah. That's another one of these great big tones that we call a balloon tone.

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: Well, I would possibly go down there to see him about fixing the horn and straightening the mule out of something like that.

ctx.x: Well, who would stand up there? You? Well, I would possibly go down there to see him about fixing the horn and straightening the mule out of something like that. And I would happen upon this jam session.
Well, listen, I want to ask you about guys in your band, but you don't have to mention who they did in what? Like going to Wakes, if you don't want to mention their names?
